# 5000 CiteCheck Test -- Answer Key

Companion to [`5000citechecktest.md`](./5000citechecktest.md). Machine twin: [`5000citechecktest-ANSWER-KEY.json`](./5000citechecktest-ANSWER-KEY.json).

## Accuracy categories (report analyzed + correct)

| Cat | Covers | Bar |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Overruled / reversed (`overruled` family and equivalent treatment rows) | 100% |
| 2 | Fabricated / identity traps (hallucinations, neighbor-page, impossible locators, ...) | 99.7% |
| 3 | Clean real cites | 99% |
| 4 | Mangled - Bluebook / form (easier) (`bluebook_variant`) | 95% |
| 5 | Mangled - hard problems (`mild_mangle`, `severe_mangle`, `page_mismatch`, `transposed_volume`, `structural`) - recover + flag | 80% |
| 6 | Unresolved (e.g. bare `Id.`) | unscored |

Full scoring rules: [Testing the API](../../testing-the-api.md). Public scoreboard: [benchmark blog](https://lawdiver.com/blog/citediver-5300-citation-benchmark).


## How to score (different checkers, different functions)

Not every product implements every function. Score fairly:

| Stance | What a correct checker must do | What a limited checker may do |
|---|---|---|
| **must_confirm** | Return a confirm verdict (`valid` or `likely_valid` as listed in Accept) | Soft-confirm (`likely_valid`) when Accept allows it; never invent a different case |
| **must_decline** | Refuse hard `valid` | Prefer the listed Accept verdict (`name_mismatch`, `implausible`, `not_in_corpus`, ...). `not_covered` / `unverified` is Partial when the product lacks that corpus slice |
| **open** | Prefer the Accept verdict when the product has the needed capability | Locator-only checkers that skip pin/name checks may confirm; pin/name-aware checkers should decline. Both paths are scored via Accept / Partial |

### Verdict vocabulary

| Verdict | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `valid` | Locator + caption (+ year/court when asserted) match a real authority |
| `likely_valid` | Soft confirm -- antique reporter, whitespace variant, or pin inside opinion |
| `name_mismatch` | Locator is real; asserted caption is not that case |
| `page_mismatch` | Correct volume/reporter/parties, but first page is wrong (often an interior pin) |
| `implausible` | Impossible volume, series, or reporter shape |
| `not_in_corpus` / `not_covered` | No match / product does not cover this authority class |
| `unverified` / `error` | Cannot decide (garbage, bare `Id.`, missing antecedent) |

### Capability tags (used per case below)

| Tag | Function |
|---|---|
| `parse_locator` | Extract vol · reporter · page (and parallels) |
| `corpus_lookup` | Resolve locator against a case database |
| `caption_match` | Compare asserted parties to the resolved case |
| `party_normalization` | T6 / sovereign expansion rules (`USA` brand vs bare `USA` party) |
| `pin_page_check` | Detect interior pin used as first page |
| `volume_plausibility` | Reject impossible volumes / invented series |
| `non_case_authority` | Statutes, rules, constitutions, specialty codes |
| `antecedent_or_empty_input` | Handle `Id.`/`supra` and non-citation prose |
| `multi_unit_parse` | String cites and subsequent-history tails |
| `treatment_history` | Overruling / negative treatment -- **required** for `overruled` family |
| `vendor_locator` | Westlaw / Lexis-style vendor cites |

| must_confirm | 2447 |
| must_decline | 2643 |
| open | 210 |

## Category 1 family: Overruled / reversed (OVRL-*)

These 100 cites are **real authorities the corpus marks as overruled**. They feed **Category 1** (100% bar) and are distinct from `bad_law` / `good_law` identity rows:

| What we test | Correct behavior |
|---|---|
| Citation identity | Must **CONFIRM** (`valid` / `likely_valid`) -- the locator is real |
| Treatment signal | Must report **overruled / negative treatment** on the candidate (`goodLaw.negative` or status `overruled`) |
| Wrong | Declining the cite as `not_in_corpus` / `implausible`, or confirming without any treatment flag |

Coverage: ~2 overruled cites for large states, 1 for other states, remainder federal. Part of the same combined 5,300 suite (not a separate exam).

## Worked examples (representative)

These illustrate how to read the key when products differ in coverage.

### TRICK-001 -- test #1435

- **Cite:** `Hunter v. Philip Morris USA, 582 F.3d 1039 (9th Cir. 2009)`
- **Correct answer:** CONFIRM as valid (or likely_valid)
- **Why:** Caption ends with Philip Morris USA; treating USA as United States is a false correction. (Trailing USA is a brand token -- must not expand to United States.)
- **Stance:** `must_confirm` · family `caption_trap`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `valid` / `likely_valid` / `name_mismatch`, `implausible`, `not_covered`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`, `caption_match`, `party_normalization`
- **Note:** Trailing corporate USA / U.S.A. is a brand token (T6); bare USA as a party expands to United States. Do not flag the brand form as a name_mismatch.

### TRICK-003 -- test #4904

- **Cite:** `State of Texas v. USA, 142 S. Ct. 522 (2021)`
- **Correct answer:** CONFIRM as valid (or likely_valid)
- **Why:** Texas v. United States -- bare USA party is the sovereign. (Bare USA as a party DOES expand to United States.)
- **Stance:** `must_confirm` · family `caption_trap`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `valid`, `likely_valid` / `name_mismatch`, `not_in_corpus`, `page_mismatch` / `implausible`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`, `caption_match`, `party_normalization`
- **Note:** Trailing corporate USA / U.S.A. is a brand token (T6); bare USA as a party expands to United States. Do not flag the brand form as a name_mismatch.

### TRICK-006 -- test #2929

- **Cite:** `Barr v. Resolution Trust Corp., 837 S.W.2d 627, 35 Tex. Sup. Ct. J. 1193 (Tex. 1992)`
- **Correct answer:** CONFIRM as valid (or likely_valid)
- **Why:** Valid cite with Texas Supreme Court Journal parallel. (Tex. Sup. Ct. J. parallel must not be parsed as a pincite.)
- **Stance:** `must_confirm` · family `parallel_trap`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `valid` / `likely_valid` / `page_mismatch`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`, `pin_page_check`

### TRICK-015 -- test #3664

- **Cite:** `Celotex, 477 U.S. at 323`
- **Correct answer:** CONFIRM as valid (or likely_valid)
- **Why:** Short form of Celotex; may be likely_valid without prior context. (Short form with pincite.)
- **Stance:** `must_confirm` · family `mild_mangle`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `valid`, `likely_valid` / `page_mismatch`, `not_covered` / `implausible`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`, `pin_page_check`

### BANK-IL-06 -- test #3605

- **Cite:** `People v. Enoch, 122 Ill. 2d 179 (1988)`
- **Correct answer:** OPEN / capability-dependent -- preferred when supported: page_mismatch
- **Why:** People v. Enoch begins at page 176, not 179. Page 179 is verified not to be any other case's first page in 122 Ill. 2d. (Correct case and volume, but an internal pin page given as the first page.)
- **Stance:** `open` · family `page_mismatch`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `page_mismatch` / `likely_valid`, `valid` / `implausible`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`, `pin_page_check`
- **Note:** Not all checkers pin-verify or name-match. A locator-only checker may return valid/likely_valid; a pin-aware checker should return the preferred decline verdict. Score either path as acceptable when listed in Accept or Partial. Pin/page-aware checkers should catch interior pages used as first pages. Locator-only checkers that skip pin verification get Partial if they confirm.

### JUR-0226-H1 -- test #2602

- **Cite:** `Northgate Indemnity Co. v. Whitcomb, 187 F. 238 (3-35-2113)`
- **Correct answer:** DECLINE -- preferred verdict: name_mismatch
- **Why:** Locator real; caption false -> name_mismatch. (Invented parties on a real occupied locator.)
- **Stance:** `must_decline` · family `close_hallucination`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `name_mismatch` / `not_in_corpus`, `implausible` / `valid`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`, `caption_match`

### REP-0275-H -- test #3452

- **Cite:** `Halcyon Data Systems v. Delacroix, 8462 F. Supp. 560 (2008)`
- **Correct answer:** DECLINE -- preferred verdict: implausible
- **Why:** Invented volume/parties in a real series. (Fabrication in reporter series F. Supp.)
- **Stance:** `must_decline` · family `outright_hallucination`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `implausible`, `not_in_corpus`, `not_covered` / `name_mismatch` / `valid`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`, `volume_plausibility`

### ANAT-A001 -- test #3134

- **Cite:** `Phillips v. Cnty. of Allegheny, 515 F.3d 224 (3d Cir. 2008)`
- **Correct answer:** CONFIRM as valid (or likely_valid)
- **Why:** confirmed, correct case and fields (Jurisdiction -- 3d Cir.)
- **Stance:** `must_confirm` · family `perfect`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `valid` / `likely_valid` / `implausible`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`

### BANK-TX-11 -- test #1830

- **Cite:** `Id. at 851`
- **Correct answer:** DECLINE -- preferred verdict: not_covered
- **Why:** Unresolvable in isolation -- there is no prior authority to attach it to. (Bare `Id.` sent with no antecedent citation in the batch.)
- **Stance:** `must_decline` · family `id_supra`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `not_covered`, `unverified`, `error` / `not_in_corpus`, `likely_valid` / `valid`, `implausible`, `name_mismatch`, `page_mismatch`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `antecedent_or_empty_input`
- **Note:** Checkers that require an antecedent for Id./supra, or that reject non-citation prose, should decline. A checker that invents a prior cite or invents a case from garbage fails.

### BANK-HI-14 -- test #2560

- **Cite:** `Haw. Rev. Stat. § 663-1`
- **Correct answer:** CONFIRM as valid (or likely_valid)
- **Why:** Haw. Rev. Stat. § 663-1 is a real provision of Hawaii law. (Real, in-force state statute in Bluebook T1.3 form.)
- **Stance:** `must_confirm` · family `statute`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `valid`, `likely_valid` / `unverified`, `not_covered`, `not_in_corpus` / `implausible`, `name_mismatch`, `page_mismatch`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `non_case_authority`
- **Note:** Case-law-only checkers may return not_covered / not_in_corpus. That is acceptable Partial credit -- do not require a caselaw confirm on statutes/rules/constitutions unless the product claims that coverage.

### BANK-KS-14 -- test #2733

- **Cite:** `Kan. Stat. Ann. § 999999.99`
- **Correct answer:** DECLINE -- preferred verdict: not_in_corpus
- **Why:** No such section exists in the Kansas code. (Real code name, impossible section number.)
- **Stance:** `must_decline` · family `statute_fabricated`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `not_in_corpus`, `not_covered`, `implausible`, `unverified` / `likely_valid`, `error` / `valid`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `non_case_authority`
- **Note:** Case-law-only checkers may return not_covered / not_in_corpus. That is acceptable Partial credit -- do not require a caselaw confirm on statutes/rules/constitutions unless the product claims that coverage.

### TRICK-021 -- test #3415

- **Cite:** `Chevron U.S.A. Inc. v. NRDC, 467 U.S. 837 (1984)`
- **Correct answer:** CONFIRM as valid (or likely_valid)
- **Why:** valid citation + overruled / negative treatment in candidate. (Citation valid; holding overruled -- negative treatment required.)
- **Stance:** `must_confirm` · family `bad_law`
- **Accept / Partial / Reject:** `valid` / `likely_valid` / `implausible`, `not_in_corpus`
- **Capabilities:** `parse_locator`, `corpus_lookup`, `treatment_history`
- **Note:** Overruling / negative treatment is orthogonal to citation validity: a checker that only verifies the cite form should still CONFIRM. Treatment signals are bonus, not required.
